test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are coloured Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White. Select the colour that will be on the face opposite to the one coloured Yellow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41c00af4b440ad6c0f8e28d536607b348b994f89721cd53051477d703b0f1de3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

If two dice have the same two face values in the given image, then third word is opposite to each other.

In given figure, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1f6e052312a32d21bf614418b1ec08b5719dd392de75ecbe27cd0fb93ac4935.png] 

Here, **Blue** and White are common.

So, the number opposite to Yellow is Green.

Hence, **option 2)** is the correct answer.
